# Not1Sam — Portfolio

> Personal portfolio of Houssam Belkasaoui (Not1Sam), a Software Engineer from Salé, Morocco.

Houssam Belkasaoui (online alias: Not1Sam) is a Software Engineer specializing in full-stack web development, DevOps, and self-hosted infrastructure. He builds scalable systems using React, TypeScript, FastAPI, and Docker, and maintains a self-hosted homelab powered by Unraid, Docker, and WireGuard VPN.

- **Education:** Software Engineering — EST Salé, Morocco (2020–2024)

## Core Skills & Technologies

- **Languages:** Python, TypeScript, JavaScript, Java, Bash
- **Frontend:** React, Vite, Tailwind CSS, React Router
- **Backend:** FastAPI, SQLAlchemy (async), Pydantic, JWT auth
- **Databases:** PostgreSQL, SQLite
- **DevOps:** Docker, Portainer, GitHub Actions, Nginx, Linux (Arch Linux, Unraid)
- **Infrastructure:** Self-hosted homelab, WireGuard VPN, Plex, Bitwarden, Dev Containers
- **Tools:** Git, Obsidian, VS Code
